## Purpose

Describe the user-visible result and why it belongs in Scribble Lab.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] Relevant browser tests pass
- [ ] Documentation matches the implemented behavior
- [ ] No generated files, credentials, or private documents are included

## Safety boundary

- [ ] This change keeps generation identity-free
- [ ] This change does not add handwriting, signature, image, or font reference inputs
- [ ] This change does not add writer matching, tracing, signature generation, or personal style extraction
